title: Grade 2 ELA — Short Passages and Text Evidence
subject: English Language Arts
description: Practice with questions on sequence, key details, cause and effect.
creator: Teach Arcade

questions.question: A snowstorm covered the path to the shed. Jada used a shovel before she carried out the birdseed. Soon the feeder had three visitors. Why did Jada likely shovel first?
A snowstorm covered the path to the shed. Jada used a shovel before she carried out the birdseed. Soon the feeder had three visitors. What happened after Jada carried birdseed out?
choices: Jada first took out the shovel.

questions.question: Ava wanted to build a paper bridge. Her first bridge fell under a toy car. She folded the sides up on her next bridge. That bridge held the car. What was Ava's problem at first?
choices: The bridge fell under the car.

questions.question: Ava wanted to build a paper bridge. Her first bridge fell under a toy car. She folded the sides up on her next bridge. That bridge held the car. What change helped the bridge work?
choices: She cut the bridge in half.

questions.question: Mateo found dry soil in a pot by the window. He added water, left the pot by the window, and checked it again later. What told Mateo that the pot might need water?
choices: The pot sat by a door.

questions.question: Mateo found dry soil in a pot by the window. He added water, left the pot by the window, and checked it again later. What stayed the same after Mateo added water?
choices: The pot’s spot by the window

questions.question: Kim made name cards for the art show. The blue cards went beside clay work and the yellow ones beside drawings. Only one drawing was missing a card. What color card did the drawing need?
Kim made name cards for the art show. The blue cards went beside clay work and the yellow ones beside drawings. Only one drawing was missing a card. Where did Kim put the blue cards?
A park sign said the pond trail was muddy. Jess and Lee chose the hill trail instead. They reached the lookout just before lunch. Why did they skip the pond trail?
choices: The sign said it was muddy.

questions.question: A park sign said the pond trail was muddy. Jess and Lee chose the hill trail instead. They reached the lookout just before lunch. Which event happened last?
choices: They found out the pond trail was muddy.

questions.question: Ava read aloud while Mel drew birds. They stopped when a timer rang. Then they took the drawings to the hall display. Who drew birds?
Ava read aloud while Mel drew birds. They stopped when a timer rang. Then they took the drawings to the hall display. What told them to stop?
Rob's family used to put kitchen scraps in the trash. Now they put fruit peels in a compost bin. They use the finished compost in their garden. Where do their fruit peels go now?
Rob's family used to put kitchen scraps in the trash. Now they put fruit peels in a compost bin. They use the finished compost in their garden. What do they use in their garden?
Sana's team planted three sunflowers. Two grew tall, but one stayed short. The short plant sat in shade next to the shed. Where was the short plant?
Sana's team planted three sunflowers. Two grew tall, but one stayed short. The short plant sat in shade next to the shed. Which could explain why that plant grew less?
choices: All three plants sat in the same shade.

questions.question: First the class made paper signs. Next they put bins by the door. Last they showed other classes where to recycle paper. What came right after making the signs?
choices: showing other classes where to go

questions.question: First the class made paper signs. Next they put bins by the door. Last they showed other classes where to recycle paper. What were the signs and bins for?
During a dry week, Ada counted only one frog by a pond. After rain, she counted five. Ada decided to keep a daily frog chart. What difference did Ada see after rain?
During a dry week, Ada counted only one frog by a pond. After rain, she counted five. Ada decided to keep a daily frog chart. What did Ada decide to do?
